# Phase 1 Foundation Checklist: QuickFlow Personal Productivity Workspace

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality check for the Phase 1 (Setup & Foundation) acceptance criteria used by loop-3 testing: navigation, accessibility, motion, layout width, API error format, CORS and API documentation.
**Created**: 2026-10-03
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Defaults applied (non-interactive): depth Standard, audience Reviewer (testing loop), focus Navigation/Accessibility + API error contract.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all six navigation destinations and their labels listed explicitly? [Completeness, Spec §FR-028, US6 AS1]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the meaning of "highlights the current page" specified, both visually and for assistive technology? [Completeness, Spec §US6 AS1]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the default route when no page is given (root URL or unknown URL) specified before Settings' default landing view exists? [Gap, Spec §FR-029]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the error response format and its fields (status, detail, field-level errors) defined for 400, 404 and 409? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the allowed browser origin for the API documented as a requirement rather than only as a task detail? [Gap, Assumption]
- [ ] CHK006 Is availability of machine-readable API documentation stated as a requirement? [Gap]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is "persistent navigation" defined for narrow screens (375 px) as well as wide screens? [Clarity, Spec §FR-028, §FR-032]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "disabled when the user prefers reduced motion" defined as zero duration or no animation at all? [Clarity, Spec §FR-032]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "every action reachable by keyboard" specified with an expected focus order for the shell (skip link first)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-034]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "visible focus indicator" given measurable properties (contrast, thickness)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-034]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Are the navigation labels consistent between US6 AS1, FR-028 and the Settings default-view options? [Consistency, Spec §FR-028, §FR-029]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the field-level error format consistent with the validation messages the UI must announce? [Consistency, Spec §FR-034]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK013 Can "each link opens its page" be objectively verified (URL, page heading, document title)? [Measurability, Spec §US6 AS1]
- [ ] CHK014 Can the 250 ms animation ceiling be objectively measured? [Measurability, Spec §FR-032]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK015 Are requirements defined for navigation when the backend is unreachable? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Gap]
- [ ] CHK016 Are requirements defined for layouts narrower than 375 px or wider than 1440 px? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-032]
- [ ] CHK017 Are requirements defined for an unknown API path (404 format)? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK018 Are landmark/name requirements (named navigation region, main region) specified for screen readers? [Coverage, Spec §FR-034]
- [ ] CHK019 Are color contrast requirements stated for both light and dark themes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-034]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
